notes: red_01, green_01 and yellow_01 are the same gable shed with a different roof; blue_01 drops the roof for an open A-frame that reads as a catapult. red_01 shield is a flame not a crown, yellow_01 shield sun reads as a purple ring/crescent, and yellow_01 makes the whole roof pale gold/cream stripes (hay-like) with purple trim, so kingdom colour is the dominant surface.
